SGRY.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 26: Surgery Partners Skyrockets 48% on $5.7 Billion HealthSpan Acquisition
SGRY.description: Surgery Partners (SGRY) surged 48% after HealthSpan Partners announced a $5.7 billion all-cash acquisition at $23.50 per share. The stock now trades just below the acquisition price, suggesting market confidence in deal completion expected in Q1 2027. However, the valuation represents a buy-low opportunity for the acquirer, as shares are near levels from a year ago.

RRC.headline: EQT Is Building a $50 Billion Natural Gas Giant as AI Power Demand Surges
RRC.description: EQT is acquiring Range Resources in an all-stock deal to create a $50 billion natural gas giant, positioning itself as the largest U.S. gas producer with over 9 Bcfe/d production capacity. The merger is driven by surging AI data center power demand, with EQT strategically locking in long-term supply agreements at premium prices. However, the company faces risks from potential AI infrastructure slowdown.
